Autonomous Nigerian Airtime distribution agent on Farcaster.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of OpenAirtime autonomous agent for Farcaster.

- Distributes Nigerian airtime via a claim-and-reply workflow on Farcaster.
- Provides strict usage instructions and built-in command examples for both airtime management and Farcaster interactions.
- Enforces duplicate reply prevention and clear response guidelines.
- Includes detailed onboarding, command explanations, and cautions on API credential handling.
- Requires Node.js for all command runs; curl is not supported.
